title.en: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD)
title.hi: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD)

definition.en: The IBRD is the lending arm of the World Bank Group that provides loans, guarantees, and advisory services to middle-income and creditworthy low-income countries to promote sustainable development.
definition.hi: The IBRD is the lending arm of the World Bank Group that provides loans, guarantees, and advisory services to middle-income and creditworthy low-income countries to promote sustainable development.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding the IBRD is crucial for the GS-3 syllabus under the 'External Sector' and 'International Institutions' sections. It helps candidates analyze India's engagement with multilateral development banks and the impact of external financing on the Indian economy.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding the IBRD is crucial for the GS-3 syllabus under the 'External Sector' and 'International Institutions' sections. It helps candidates analyze India's engagement with multilateral development banks and the impact of external financing on the Indian economy.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the operational mandate and financial structure of the IBRD.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of IBRD in supporting India's infrastructure and social sector projects.
